answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can earn: the stake is slashed on proven fraud, so an attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund each one. Reputation then accrues only through attested work, letting a newcomer nebula of identities stay harmless until it proves itself. At the nadir of trust, zero-stake agents can only observe, never transact, which makes sybil farming cost more than it can ever earn.
